niche: an implementing non-profit's forecast, for its donor, of how many Ombeni fever cases the March 2027 county-wide distribution of repellent sleeping nets in Ruvari County will avert among the people sleeping under them from April to December 2027, when the county's vector bites earlier in the evening and more outdoors than at any site of the five-site trial that measured the nets' protective efficacy
answer: About 11,000 Ombeni fever cases averted among the people sleeping under the March 2027 LulaNet R nets in Ruvari County from April to December 2027, 21 per cent of the 53,042 cases the county expects (11,208 unrounded from the shipped files).
answer_source: submission.md, 1. Final Recommendation (generator/deliver.py from the pack; generator/verify.py recomputes)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the entomology and survey records, reads the trial report and the campaign plan correctly and applies the trial's pooled protective efficacy (56.7 per cent) to the plan's expected cases among net users files 22,000 cases averted (8,000 when it multiplies that efficacy by the county's in-bed share of bites without dividing out the trial sites' own), when the per-bite protection the five sites share (0.80), carried through the county's in-bed share of exposure (0.36), files 11,000.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a vector-control tool's protective efficacy transported to a new setting through the share of human exposure to the vector that arrives while people are in bed under the net (the vector's hourly biting indoors and outdoors read against the population's hourly location), built from human landing catches and a human behaviour survey the way vector-control impact models carry trial efficacy; with hospital or school nouns there is no vector rhythm against people's sleeping hours for the protection to miss.

hour bins labelled two ways after a field-team change, and a 12-hour clock in one year's sheets

world.geography: Kenya (Ruvari County, a fictional lakeshore county; its health department, the implementing partner, the donor, Ombeni fever, its vector, the trial and every record are fictional)
world.org_type: an implementing non-profit running vector control with the county health department

driver: A protection acts only on the exposure that arrives while the protected state holds, so an efficacy measured in a trial is a per-exposure protection times the share of its own sites' exposure that arrived in that state; the target's share is the overlap of when and where exposure arrives with when people are in the protected state, read hour by hour from two records at a finer grain than the trial's headline, and carrying the trial's efficacy, or multiplying it by the target's share without dividing out the sites' own, misstates the forward effect.
driver_concrete: Ruvari County's Ombeni fever vector bites from dusk and half of it outdoors, so only 0.36 of a resident's bites arrive while in bed under a net, against 0.49 to 0.96 at the KINGA-5 sites; the nets' pooled protective efficacy of 56.7 per cent is a per-bite protection of 0.80 times each site's in-bed share, so the cases averted among users from April to December 2027 are the plan's baseline times the planned use times 0.80 times 0.36, not the trial's efficacy and not that efficacy times the county's share.
stump: A competent solver applies the trial's pooled protective efficacy of 56.7 per cent to the plan's expected cases among net users and files 22,000 cases averted against 11,000; the step that lands it there is carrying an efficacy measured where most bites arrived after participants were in bed to a county whose vector bites early and half outdoors, where 0.36 of a resident's bites arrive in bed against 0.49 to 0.96 at the sites.

differentiation.task177: there an offer moves a subscriber mainly in the days before the subscriber's own recurring bill, so a test's average over the billing cycle does not carry; here no unit has a cycle of its own: a protection acts only while people are in bed, and the share of exposure it can reach is the hourly overlap of two independently measured rhythms (the vector's biting indoors and outdoors and the population's location), with the trial's own sites' overlap divided out of its headline efficacy
differentiation.task149: the same task type: there a hazard per hour rises with work pace read within each site; here a trial efficacy is transported through an exposure overlap

lineage.driver: Units move to another line at the first of their scheduled measurements that reads at or above a fixed level, and a single measurement scatters around each unit's own path by more than the path rises between measurements, so most moves come months before the paths reach the level; only the chance that each scheduled measurement reads over the level, taken from each unit's own path and the record's scatter, forecasts them, while paths projected to the level, a fixed age, the recent count of moves, the moves seen at each recorded level or a pooled rate each misplace them.
lineage.driver_concrete: Children on paediatric antiretroviral regimens move to adult TLD at the first clinic weighing that reads 30 kg or more, and a clinic weighing scatters more than a kilogram either side of a child's own growth line while the line rises about a fifth of a kilogram a month, so most switches come months before the line reaches 30 kg; the children's line of the C7 order needs each child's chance of a qualifying weighing at each visit its own dispensing interval schedules, and projecting growth to 30 kg, a switch age, the recent switch count or the switch rate by last recorded weight each misplace the line by a pallet or more, the register's own rates because its switches came under the 35 kg band and at the monthly visits the 2026 guidelines replaced.
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits each child's growth line from the register, switches the child to TLD at the first scheduled visit after the line reaches 30 kg and files line 2 at 10 pallets against 11, because the first weighing that reads 30 kg comes months before the line gets there.
lineage.analyst_test: With every field read, the 2026 dosing band applied as filed and the SOP's line 2 built as filed, a strong analyst projects each child's weighings forward on a fitted growth line, moves the child to TLD when the line reaches 30 kg and files line 2 at 10 pallets of 8,064 bottles, one pallet below the 11 the scheduled weighings imply.
lineage.domain_test: The line turns on the paediatric regimen-transition forecast of ARV quantification, the patient-months on TLD of children who will be weighed into the 30 kg band at their scheduled visits, built from each child's weighings, the clinics' weighing scatter, each child's dispensing interval and retention; with another field's nouns the dosing band applied at a clinic weighing, the dispensing interval and the cycle order's paediatric line stop meaning anything.
